newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan-May home aluminium sales up 13.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan-May home aluminium sales up 13.6 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 87,100 tonnes in January to May, up 13.6 percent on the 76,700 tonnes sold in the same period in 1996, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
Sales in May reached 16,800 tonnes, up 1.8 percent from 16,500 tonnes in May last year but down 12.5 percent on the 19,200 tonnes sold in April 1997.
The drop is due to fewer working days in May and also to a number of sector beginning to feel the impact of recent consumer credit restrictions, ABAL said.
